content: The Guide to Using Questionnaire Design Studio (QDS) eQuestionnaire Materials outlines the three formats of core questionnaire modules derived from the Blue Book (BBSG). These formats are contained within the QDS file and are described as follows: 1. Full Survey and Screening Modules: This file includes all core modules and questions from the Questionnaire Modules. It is recommended for use when both screening and interview administration will occur on the same tablet, in the same location, or under the supervision of a single staff member. The relevant files for this format are: `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Screening_Interview.RTF` `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Screening_Interview.QDS` `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Screening_Interview_ACASI.QSI` 2. Screening Modules Only: This file contains only the screening modules from the core Questionnaire Modules. It is suitable for scenarios where a participant is screened in one location or by one staff member and then moved to another location or staff member for interview oversight and administration. If using this file, you must also use the interview files listed in section 3 below. The relevant files for this format are: `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Screening_EnScript.RTF` `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Screening.QDS` `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Screening_ACASI.QSI` 3. Interview Modules Only: This file contains only the interview modules from the core Questionnaire Modules. It is recommended for use when a participant is screened in one location or by one staff member and then moved to another location or staff member for interview oversight and administration. If using this file, you must also use the screening files listed in section 2 above. The relevant files for this format are: `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Interview_EnScript.RTF` `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Interview.QDS` `QDS_eQuestionnaire_Interview_ACASI.QSI` The files ending in `.RTF` are interview scripts, which allow an interviewer to view the questions and answer options outside of the QDS system. Files ending in `.QDS` contain the questions, answers, skip patterns, restrictions, and other elements of the eQuestionnaire. These files are used if you wish to modify the questions or answer options in any way. Files ending in `.QSI` are the ACASI (Audio Computer-Assisted Self-Interviewing) interview files. When opened, these files launch the interview interface that participants and interviewers will use.
